recipes.name: Blackberry Ginger Iced Green Tea
instructions: Add the green tea to the hot water and let it steep until it cools down completely.
To a blender, add the blackberries, frozen pineapple, lime, ginger, and maple syrup. Blend until smooth.
Strain the blended blackberry mixture through a sieve to remove the seeds.
To assemble, first divide the puréed blackberry mixture between the glasses, followed by mint, lime slices, and ice cubes, and finish with the cooled green tea.
Stir and add more sweetener to taste. Garnish and enjoy!
